min support bitmask as an integer.  S prec T iff max(S xor T) in T.

spec.note: DEGENERATE by the pinned 'one selection per slope' semantics: z is constant on W_z, so the leading key never separates and the induced selection equals the tail order's.  Verified computationally (selected families identical to ORD-POLYLEX).
spec.summary: slope-major lexicographic: order the full witness datum (z, p, S) with the slope as the leading key, then ORD-POLYLEX, then ORD-LEX.
value-major lexicographic (support reading): coordinates re-indexed by the integer representative of x in F_q, then lex on the increasing tuple.
